meta.source: Drawn from the schedule reference Fadhul chose (soft grey ground, navy, pill controls, tonal card cascade, white cards on navy), keeping MedSync's clinical safety colours from Chroma unchanged.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Near-white by day, navy at night. Not pure white: cards are the white things, lifted by shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, fields, the date tile. The bright objects on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating things: the nav pill, sheets, dialogs, toasts in light.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed fills, skeleton shapes, the track behind segmented pills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. A navy ink, never pure black or pure white.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, places, supporting lines. 6.6:1 on bg in light, 7.8:1 in navy.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and inactive nav icons. Passes 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of secondary buttons, fields and unselected chips.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lagoon, the one action colour: primary pill buttons, the centre plus, the selected segment, the active nav dot. Always with accent-on text.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Navy on lagoon is 8.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, text buttons, 'Change'. Lagoon itself is too light for text on grey.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft accent fills: soft buttons, a selected chip, the halo behind the centre plus.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings, 2px with a 2px gap.

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Fixed. Deepest band, the text on foam.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Fixed. Cascade step 1 (earliest), header bands, the dark ground.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Fixed. Dark-theme cards.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Fixed. Dark-theme raised surfaces.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Fixed. Muted fills on navy bands.

tokens.name: cascade-1
tokens.usage: Day cascade, earliest step. White text.

tokens.name: cascade-2
tokens.usage: Day cascade, second step (ocean). White text 9.5:1.

tokens.name: cascade-3
tokens.usage: Day cascade, third step (sea). White text 6.0:1.

tokens.name: cascade-now
tokens.usage: Day cascade, the item that is due now. Navy text. The brightest card on screen.

tokens.name: cascade-next
tokens.usage: Day cascade, what comes after now (foam). Navy text.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on navy bands and cascade steps 1 to 3.

tokens.name: on-band-2
tokens.usage: Supporting text on navy bands and cascade steps 1 to 3 (5.0:1 on cascade-3, more on the others).

tokens.name: area-readings
tokens.usage: Place dot and icon for Readings. Dots and icons only, never a fill behind text, never a button.

tokens.name: area-medicines
tokens.usage: Place dot and icon for Medicines, refills and the lab.

tokens.name: area-visits
tokens.usage: Place dot and icon for Visits and clinics.

tokens.name: area-team
tokens.usage: Place dot and icon for the care team and messages.

tokens.name: area-me
tokens.usage: Place dot and icon for Me, household and settings.

tokens.name: status-stable-bg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned, carried from Chroma. 'In your range' pill fill.

tokens.name: status-stable-fg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned. 'In your range' text and icon.

tokens.name: status-caution-bg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned. 'Above your target' fill. Amber means health, never decoration or offline.

tokens.name: status-caution-fg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned, proposed AA value pending sign-off.

tokens.name: status-critical-bg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned. 'Danger' fill and the danger header.

tokens.name: status-critical-fg
tokens.usage: CSO-owned, proposed AA value. Out-of-range values at weight 700 with an arrow.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: 'Waiting for the clinic' fill.

tokens.name: status-pending-fg
tokens.usage: 'Waiting for the clinic' text.

tokens.name: emergency
tokens.usage: The Help button and 'Get help now' only. The one red fill in the app. White text 4.8:1.

tokens.name: on-emergency
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the emergency fill.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen, the screen's headline. Two lines at most.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Dates in the rail, reading values. Tabular figures.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and row titles, section heads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sit and rest for five minutes first.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Scales with the phone's text size to 200%.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Nav labels, month under a date, tags.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small caps labels above a title.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booking codes only, the thing shown at the desk.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips, icon to text in rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen headline.

tokens.name: cascade-overlap
tokens.usage: How far each cascade card slides under the one before it. Always more than radius-xl, so no card's square bottom corner shows beside the next card's rounded top.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest thing a thumb may hit.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary button height.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Floating nav pill height, plus a 16px bump for the centre plus.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, non-pill buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the date tile's open side.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cascade cards, sheets, header bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, segments, the nav pill, status pills, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the date tile.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The nav pill, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Glow under the centre plus and the primary pill. Nothing else glows.

tokens.name: shadow-emergency
tokens.usage: Under the Help button only.
